انتدبتا (form VIII)
# اِنْتَدَبَتَا (intadabatā) /in.ta.da.ba.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِنْتَدَبَ (intadaba)
# اُنْتُدِبَتَا (untudibatā) /un.tu.di.ba.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِنْتَدَبَ (intadaba)
